title: thelypteris subcordata
intro: Thelypteris subcordata, commonly known as the narrow-leaved maiden fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris subcordata include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's efficacy and potential side effects, and it should be used with caution.
